implementation_notes: PDF, DOCX, TXT, PNG and JPG/JPEG accepted in current intake path.

requirement: Validate declared type, file signature, size and quarantine before parsing
implementation_notes: Byte limit and file signatures are checked; durable quarantine scanning is not implemented.

requirement: Preserve original binary and create immutable SHA-256 content versions
implementation_notes: Original bytes stored under opaque version key; SHA-256 and version number retained.

requirement: Extract text, tables and layout blocks with page/paragraph/offset provenance
implementation_notes: TXT, searchable PDF and DOCX paragraph/table extraction; full layout fidelity and scanned-PDF OCR absent.

requirement: OCR PNG/JPG and embedded visual text with region coordinates and extraction confidence
implementation_notes: PNG/JPG Tesseract word boxes and confidence; PDF/DOCX embedded image OCR absent.

requirement: Create owner-controlled, versioned Brand Knowledge Packs
implementation_notes: Build 013 adds tenant+brand namespaces, Build 012 filesystem migration, neutral empty starter packs, source registry, immutable version snapshots, database-backed draft/catalogue/active pointer/record-decision history and revision-checked publication. Controlled source-document import, malware scanning, typed guided authoring, richer validation/version diff, PostgreSQL runtime verification and browser evidence remain pending.

requirement: Represent facts with source, owner, status, scope, qualifiers and validity metadata
implementation_notes: Synthetic facts include source/status, scope, qualifiers, valid time and optional record/system time; immutable pack snapshots preserve the reviewed facts; normalized bitemporal DB governance remains pending.

requirement: Represent policy clauses with severity, scope, owner, version and validity
implementation_notes: Build 013 persists policy owner decisions in a database-backed draft and append-only decision ledger. Full typed schema, scope/date conflict validation, guided authoring and PostgreSQL runtime verification remain pending.

requirement: Represent preferred terminology, prohibited variants and locale scope
implementation_notes: Build 013 retains owner approve/reject provenance and stores decisions in a database-backed draft ledger; verification ignores explicitly draft/rejected terms. Guided locale/scope/exception forms and normalized per-record tables remain pending.

requirement: Represent tone rules and approved voice examples
implementation_notes: Voice traits/examples/disallowed patterns are editable in Brand Owner drafts and published immutably; calibrated analysis and guided voice authoring remain out of scope.

requirement: Maintain approved asset versions and match candidates to them
implementation_notes: Build 012 adds private PNG/JPEG/WebP upload, decoded-image and dimension/size validation, SHA-256 metadata, draft preview, owner decision, publication and hash verification on validation/read. Malware scanning, SVG upload, allowed-use geometry/palette rules and automated identity matching remain pending.
